description: This file defines utility methods for calculating the next deposit date in a savings account, based on different recurrence frequencies and last deposit date.

classes.name: DepositAccountUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to calculate the next deposit date based on last deposit date and recurrence frequency.

methods.name: calculateNextDepositDate
methods.description: Calculates the next deposit date based on the last deposit date, recurrence frequency type, and interval.

methods.name: calculateNextDepositDate
methods.description: Overloaded method that calculates the next deposit date based on last deposit date and recurrence string, internally determining the frequency type and interval.
